**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation of any kind. Section 3 (Contractor's Compensation) — the only pricing provision — deals solely with time-and-materials compensation per Statement of Work, expense reimbursement, invoicing detail, Contractor's right to change rates on 30 days' notice, and taxes. Targeted searches across the full document for "most favoured/favorable", "no less favorable", "best", third-party price-matching and rate language returned nothing.

Because there is no clause requiring Clear Capital to extend RadialSpark terms no less favourable than those given to third parties (and nothing requiring us to match third-party offers), the preferred position — no MFN burden on the Customer — is already met. Consistent with the rule's direction analysis, the absence of a Vendor-granted MFN in our favour is a missed benefit rather than a playbook breach, so I have not redlined.
